purpose: Single law for the Devin CLI setup — the devin-setup/ twin of hack-setup's codex-pin/stack-pin. All Devin-facing versions, session law, hooks, MCP servers and orchestration surfaces are pinned here; check_devin_setup.py enforces the projection.

devin_cli.install_layout: installs to ~/.local/share/devin/cli/_versions/<ver> with a 'current' symlink and a ~/.local/bin/devin shim
devin_cli.notes: Versioned setup scripts are published per release (static.devin.ai/cli/<ver>/setup.{sh,ps1}). `devin update` would drift the pin — auto_update is pinned off in the managed user config.

herdr.install_layout: single binary on PATH (~/.local/bin/herdr); Windows zip keeps its ConPTY runtime beside herdr.exe
herdr.notes: Devin CLI is a session-identity integration: `herdr integration install devin` writes herdr-agent-state.{sh,ps1} + hook entries into the devin user config; lifecycle state still comes from herdr's screen manifest. Native restore runs `devin --resume <id>`.

session.permission_mode_note: Bypass = approval_policy never + no OS sandbox, the Devin equivalent of registered.session. There is no config-file key for the default mode — install/env.sh exports DEVIN_PERMISSION_MODE=bypass; `/bypass`, `/yolo`, `/dangerous` and `--permission-mode bypass` are the in-session forms.
session.subagents_note: Same law as codex `features.multi_agent=false`: the agent does all work itself; workers are real sessions via herdr, not subagents.
session.auto_update_note: Background auto-update would drift the pinned devin_cli.version.
session.attribution_note: Devin defaults attribution=true ("Generated with Devin" / Co-Authored-By on commits and PRs); team law: commit messages carry only the message, no AI attribution.
session.read_config_from_note: Devin defaults import foreign tool config (.claude rules+MCP+commands, .windsurf, .cursor, copilot skills, opencode MCP). The pin's projection disables silent imports — this repo's law is explicit, not inherited.

models.selection_note: swe-2-max is the only Devin model. Four projections: user-config agent.model + agent.preferred_family_models (managed block), DEVIN_MODEL exported by install/env.sh|ps1 (herdr workers inherit it), and the devin_mode.py PreToolUse model law that blocks agent-launched `devin --model <other>` / DEVIN_MODEL=<other>. Interactive `/model`, `/fusion` and Adaptive are human-only switches — do not use them; org-wide enforcement is Devin Team Settings (model allowlist).

mcp_note: Same six servers as the codex projection (stack-pin registered.mcp_servers) — check_devin_setup.py enforces semantic equality. Devin mcp_config.json uses the Claude layout: stdio {command,args,env}, remote {url,headers}; secrets are ${VAR} references, never literals.

wired.PreToolUse: lane guard on the exec tool

hooks.notes: Devin hook I/O: stdin JSON {hook_event_name, tool_name, tool_input, session_id, prompt_id}; stdout {decision|reason} or {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName, additionalContext}}; exit 2 blocks. DEVIN_PROJECT_DIR carries the repo root. Plugin hooks are best-effort fail-open — guardrails live at project layer, like codex.

orchestration.model: main Devin session talks to the user; workers are real Devin sessions spawned through herdr panes (codex_app thread equivalent)

commands.resume: devin --resume <session-id> / devin -c (herdr native restore uses session references)
commands.topology: cmux panes/workspaces host the outer layout on macOS; herdr panes host the agents
